evals.prompt: I want to capture Dan Abramov's React expertise into a skill. He's on GitHub as gaearon.
evals.expected_output: A working skill that emulates Dan Abramov's React development patterns.
assertions: Generated SKILL.md has valid YAML frontmatter with name and description
Gotchas section contains at least 5 React patterns Dan would flag
References directory contains domain-knowledge.md
Communication style section captures Dan's explanation patterns
The skill can be installed and used for React code review tasks
Scripts capture.py ran without error fetching GitHub profile

evals.prompt: Research the author of a popular tech blog and turn their cloud architecture expertise into a reusable skill. The blog is at https://www.allthingsdistributed.com/
evals.expected_output: A persona skill based on comprehensive blog scraping.
assertions: Scripts crawl_blog function scraped the blog content
Persona profile includes decision heuristics extracted from blog posts
Generated skill follows progressive disclosure pattern
At least 3 distinct technical opinions are captured as gotchas
validate.py passes all structural checks

evals.prompt: Capture the expertise of a typical senior Rust systems engineer. I don't have a specific person — just the archetype.
evals.expected_output: A skill that emulates a senior Rust engineer's patterns based on researching multiple exemplars.
assertions: Multiple real Rust experts were researched as exemplars
Common patterns across exemplars are synthesized
Gotchas cover ownership, lifetimes, unsafe code, async patterns
The archetype is clearly labeled as synthetic
Confidence assessment shows lower scores for synthetic archetype

evals.prompt: Improve the spirit-forge skill itself using the Capture→Distill→Forge methodology.
assertions: Capture phase identifies weaknesses in current skill methodology
Distill phase extracts improvement patterns
Forge phase produces improvements to spirit-forge itself
The improvement is evidence-based, not speculative
validate.py confirms the improved skill still passes all checks

evals.prompt: Run the full pipeline on gaearon with L1 depth and verify each phase produces expected output files.
assertions: capture.py produces raw-research/ with meta.json, code-patterns.md, writings.md, gotchas.md
distill.py produces persona-profile.json with expertise, heuristics, style, gotchas fields
forge.py produces generated-skill/ with SKILL.md, references/, .claude-plugin/plugin.json
validate.py returns exit code 0 on the generated skill
Pipeline completes in under 5 minutes for L1 depth
